answer.reason: The keys of STAGE_OF_PHASE (scheduled, candling, ramping, holding, cooling, complete, faulted) are KilnwisePhase's seven values lowercased, one for one, and PieceService looks them up straight from the vendor's phaseCode text. The studio glossary names its own stages differently (queued, drying, heating, soaking, easing, done, broken), and those names live in FiringStage, not in the keys.
